full_text:
# **Circular** <u>To all insurers and insurance intermediaries,</u> 

Ref : IRDAI/GA&HR/CIR/MISC/167/8/2022 09.08.2022      Date : 09.08.2022 **Migration of BAP to new hardware and the latest software** IRDAI is in the process of upgrading BAP and is being migrated to new hardware and the latest software. Due to this process, BAP will not be available for any functional use from 10th August 8 pm to 16th August 9 am. In this regard, you are requested to ensure that all activities connected with BAP are carried out before 10th August 8 pm.
